title: Thai Fritter Stir Fry
description: A flavorful and spicy Thai stir-fry dish made with crispy fritters and a variety of vegetables.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the Canadian peas and blackeye peas to the skillet and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes.
Add the Jazzy Fritters to the skillet and stir-fry for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Season the dish with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the stir-fry hot and garnish with chopped green onions if desired.
